audit_criterion.text: If a finite choice is already impossible from fixed finite state, the question surface must not present it as locally admissible.

field_families.referent: the finite ClaimIR claim-type classification for the source claim
semantic_prerequisites: source claim is in the frozen synthetic bundle
wire_prerequisites: choice is in the frozen claim-type vocabulary
field_families.not_applicable_condition: none; the claim-level field is always required
downstream_invariants: decision.claim_type is one frozen finite value

field_families.referent: the finite ClaimIR modality classification for the source claim
semantic_prerequisites: source claim is in the frozen synthetic bundle
wire_prerequisites: choice is in the frozen modality vocabulary
field_families.not_applicable_condition: none; the claim-level field is always required
downstream_invariants: decision.modality is one frozen finite value

field_families.referent: whether a source evidence unit contributes to a named scope bucket
semantic_prerequisites: the source evidence unit is identified
the intended applicability/provenance distinction is known
wire_prerequisites: one binary scope question exists for each field and source span
field_families.not_applicable_condition: a source span is not in the bounded synthetic source bundle
downstream_invariants: scope arrays contain unique known source-span identifiers
field_families.current_enforcement_point: build_questions scope__<field>__<span> -> decision_from_answers scope reconstruction; applicability semantics are not separately enforced

field_families.referent: the source-grounded entity or structural referent represented by a node slot such as n1
semantic_prerequisites: the latent referent has been bound to the node slot
wire_prerequisites: only an anonymous slot-existence question is present before role/anchor/span answers
field_families.not_applicable_condition: the node slot is absent from the source claim
downstream_invariants: activation and all dependent node choices describe the same referent
field_families.current_enforcement_point: no pre-activation referent-binding check; slot identity is only carried by the question name and later decision object

field_families.referent: whether the bound node referent is required by the source claim
wire_prerequisites: nX__active choice is present and in yes/no vocabulary
field_families.not_applicable_condition: node slot is not required by the claim
downstream_invariants: active nodes have required dependent fields
inactive dependent values are ignored by reconstruction
field_families.current_enforcement_point: decision_from_answers active-node loop; active=no skips dependent semantic reconstruction without pruning the wire questions

field_families.referent: the ClaimIR role of an active node referent
wire_prerequisites: nX__role choice is present and in the finite role vocabulary
downstream_invariants: an active node has exactly one role
field_families.current_enforcement_point: parse_systemone_response vocabulary check and decision_from_answers._resolved after node_active=yes

field_families.referent: the single evidence-unit anchor identifying an active node referent
wire_prerequisites: nX__anchor choice is present and names a known source span
downstream_invariants: the anchor is included in the node source-span set
distinct relation arguments have distinct anchors
field_families.current_enforcement_point: decision_from_answers anchor-in-refs check and relation anchor-distinction check

field_families.referent: the source evidence units that ground an active node referent
wire_prerequisites: one yes/no span-membership question exists for each bounded source span
downstream_invariants: an active node has at least one source span
node_anchor is in node_source_spans
field_families.current_enforcement_point: decision_from_answers fails with active node requires at least one source span when the selected set is empty

field_families.referent: whether the active node grounding is explicit or normalized
wire_prerequisites: nX__grounding choice is present and in the finite grounding vocabulary
downstream_invariants: grounding is copied into the deterministic decision record
field_families.current_enforcement_point: parse_systemone_response vocabulary check and decision_from_answers._resolved after node_active=yes

field_families.referent: the source-grounded relation or dependency represented by a relation slot such as r1
semantic_prerequisites: relation identity and its participating node referents are established
wire_prerequisites: only an anonymous relation-slot question family is present
field_families.not_applicable_condition: the relation slot is absent from the source claim
downstream_invariants: relation semantics must not be inferred solely from a slot label
field_families.current_enforcement_point: no dedicated relation-slot referent binding; this audit remains AUDIT_UNDERDETERMINED

field_families.referent: whether a bound relation referent is required by the source claim
wire_prerequisites: rX__active choice is present and in yes/no vocabulary
field_families.not_applicable_condition: relation slot is not required by the claim
downstream_invariants: an active relation has kind, arguments, grounding, and at least one source span
field_families.current_enforcement_point: decision_from_answers relation loop; active=no skips dependent semantic reconstruction

field_families.referent: the finite ClaimIR relation kind of an active relation
wire_prerequisites: rX__kind choice is present and in the finite relation vocabulary
downstream_invariants: an active relation has exactly one kind
field_families.current_enforcement_point: parse_systemone_response vocabulary check and decision_from_answers._resolved after relation_active=yes

field_families.referent: the first active node referent participating in an active relation
wire_prerequisites: rX__arg1 choice is present and names one finite node slot
downstream_invariants: arg1 names an active node
arg1 and arg2 are distinct when both are present
field_families.current_enforcement_point: decision_from_answers checks inactive-node membership and duplicate arguments after wire parsing

field_families.referent: the optional second active node referent participating in an active relation
wire_prerequisites: rX__arg2 choice is present and is none or one finite node slot
field_families.not_applicable_condition: relation_active=no or the relation has unary arity
downstream_invariants: none means no second argument
a present second argument is active
distinct arguments have distinct anchors
field_families.current_enforcement_point: decision_from_answers converts none to unary arity and then checks duplicate/inactive/anchor constraints

field_families.referent: the source evidence units that ground an active relation
wire_prerequisites: one yes/no span-membership question exists for each bounded source span
downstream_invariants: an active relation has at least one source span
field_families.current_enforcement_point: decision_from_answers fails with active relation requires at least one source span when the selected set is empty

field_families.referent: whether the active relation grounding is explicit or normalized
wire_prerequisites: rX__grounding choice is present and in the finite grounding vocabulary
downstream_invariants: grounding is copied into the deterministic decision record
field_families.current_enforcement_point: parse_systemone_response vocabulary check and decision_from_answers._resolved after relation_active=yes

probes.synthetic_case: Anonymous n1 activation is requested before any referent binding.
probes.witness: The slot-existence question cannot distinguish referent selection from activation.

probes.synthetic_case: Two latent source-supported referents are indistinguishable at n1__active.
probes.witness: Both latent assignments have the same state at the activation question but require different activation answers.

probes.synthetic_case: r1 active = yes; arg1 = n1; arg2 = n1.
probes.compiler_failure: r1: duplicate relation arguments are forbidden
probes.witness: The tuple uses only finite wire choices but is impossible from fixed active-node state.

probes.synthetic_case: An active relation argument names an inactive node.
probes.compiler_failure: r1: relation argument names inactive node
probes.witness: The argument vocabulary is independent of the already-known active node set.

probes.synthetic_case: Distinct relation arguments are active but have the same anchor.
probes.failure: distinct relation arguments require distinct node anchors
probes.compiler_failure: r1: distinct relation arguments require distinct node anchors
probes.witness: The wire surface admits two node names whose fixed anchor state cannot distinguish them.

probes.synthetic_case: A historical provenance date is contrasted with an actual temporal restriction on the claim.
probes.witness: The binary temporal scope membership question does not state whether date mention is provenance or applicability.

probes.synthetic_case: An evidential-support span is contrasted with an applicability/scope span.
probes.witness: Support for a claim need not itself be a condition, population, task, or temporal restriction.

probes.synthetic_case: Inactive node: active = no; all dependent fields = __unresolved__.
probes.witness: Inactive unresolved dependents are not resolved into the decision and do not manufacture abstention.

probes.synthetic_case: Active node: active = yes; required role = __unresolved__.
probes.witness: An unresolved active required field fails closed at semantic decision reconstruction.

probes.synthetic_case: The full wire requires dependent answers even when a node is semantically inactive.
probes.n_a_conclusion: Semantically inactive dependent fields require explicit N/A semantics or omission; the current mandatory full wire supplies neither.
probes.witness: Omission fails exact coverage, while arbitrary or unresolved inactive values compile identically after active=no.

probes.synthetic_case: Active node has no selected source spans.
probes.failure: active node requires at least one source span
probes.compiler_failure: n1: active node requires at least one source span
probes.witness: The per-span wire choices permit an empty grounding set even though active-node state makes it impossible.
Qualification is deterministic and consumes no real source, model, or server operation.

destroyed_clauses: node activation always has a well-defined referent
finite structurally impossible combinations are excluded before reconstruction
scope membership uniquely distinguishes applicability from provenance/evidence
all mandatory questions have meaningful semantics when inactive
surviving_properties: inactive unresolved dependents do not manufacture abstention

parent_postmortem_linkage.p3_independently_reproduces: the same failure class as #197 B0001 using synthetic data

properties: node referent must be bound before activation/role classification
dependent finite choices should exclude choices already impossible from fixed state
scope semantics must distinguish applicability restriction from provenance/evidential support
semantically inactive dependent fields require explicit N/A semantics or omission
